#1 fixed. Root cause: `d.tz(input, timezone)` in src/plugin/timezone/index.js always ran the string/wall-clock parsing path (`d.utc(input).valueOf()` + `fixOffset`), so absolute instants (numeric timestamp, native Date, dayjs object) were shifted by the target zone's offset. Fix: non-string inputs now go through the instance `.tz(timezone)` conversion. Full suite: 56 suites / 524 tests pass, no regressions.
Urgent — treating #11 (weekYear plugin, `yearStart: 4`) as top priority. ETA ~8 min.
For `plural('минута_минуты_минут', 22)`: 22 % 10 = 2 (in 2–4) and 22 % 100 = 22 (≥ 20), so it returns `forms[1]`, i.e. `'минуты'`.
#1 is fixed and verified (full suite 56 suites / 524 tests pass).
#4 still in progress — the `Z` offset formatting path is being fixed and regression-tested. ETA ~4 min.

In src/locale/si.js, `formats.LT` is `'a h:mm'` (line 13).

#11 fixed (urgent). Root cause: `proto.weekYear` in src/plugin/weekYear/index.js only handled the "late December in week 1 → next year" direction, so with `yearStart: 4` locales (en-gb, fr, cs, …) an early-January date in week 52/53 wrongly returned the calendar year. Added the mirror rule: January in week ≥ 52 → `year - 1`. Full suite passes with no new failures.
